name: Grey Club-rush
desc: Grey Club-rush (Schoenoplectus tabernaemontani): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Schoenoplectus tabernaemontani is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family known by the common names grey club-rush, softstem bulrush, and great bulrush.
